products.title: Seel Product Protection
products.body_html:
Protect your purchase beyond the scope and duration of the original manufacturer’s warranty.We’ll repair or replace the item for you when it encounters:

- Mechanical failure: Internal parts or components break down, leading to malfunction

- Electrical failure: Disruption in electrical components causing issues like power surges, short circuits, or incorrect voltage distribution, leading to malfunction

- Drops, Spills, and Accidents: Unexpected accidents or mishaps leading to physical damage or malfunction

Visit Seel Resolution Center to easily resolve your product failure issues if any of the above happens.

Please note: The Protection Plan is a value-added service offered by Seel. You need to add the Protection Plan to a specific product. Please don't purchase it as a stand-alone item.

products.title: CATLINK Self-Cleaning Litter Box - Scooper Open-X Pro
products.body_html:
Meet the All-New CATLINK Scooper Open-X Pro — More Room. A Clearer View. Smarter Cat Care.

Say goodbye to cramped litter boxes. With an open-top design and 4.6% more interior space than Open-X, the Open-X Pro gives cats more room to move and get comfortable—making the switch to a smart litter box feel more natural.

A Clearer View of Every Visit
The new side-mounted camera gives you a clearer view of your cat’s litter box visits and helps identify individual cats more accurately. In a multi-cat home, it’s easier to know who’s using the litter box and keep track of their routines.

More Room to Get Comfortable
A little extra space makes a difference. With 4.6% more interior space, Open-X Pro gives your cat more freedom to turn around, find a comfortable position, and do their business.

Smarter Detection for Added Safety
A new radar system detects approaching cats more quickly, adding another layer of protection. Paired with an incomplete gear design that keeps the entrance open, Open-X Pro helps your cat come and go with ease.

Less Scooping. More Convenience.
A spacious 12L waste drawer holds up to 15 days of waste for one cat, so you can spend less time emptying the bin and more time enjoying life with your cat.

Easy Connection
With support for both 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi, Open-X Pro fits easily into your home’s network.

Freshness Made Simple
A sealed waste bin paired with an Odor Eliminator helps keep unpleasant smells contained and your home feeling fresh. When it’s time for a deeper clean, one-touch emptying makes it easy to remove used litter and get started.

Keep the Litter Your Cat Loves
Compatible with clumping cat litter, Open-X Pro lets you upgrade your routine while keeping something familiar for your cat.

More space for your cat. More insight for you. Less scooping every day. Discover smarter everyday cat care with Open-X Pro.

products.title: Litter Refiller for CATLINK Scoop Robot Pro
products.body_html:
Meet the All-New CATLINK Scoop Robot Pro
Peace of mind—even when you're away.
The CATLINK Scoop Robot is built to make litter box care easier, cleaner, and smarter. This upgraded version includes Dual-Camera AI Vision and lifetime multi-cat recognition already unlocked—no subscriptions or hidden fees.
Monitor your cats, maintain a cleaner home, and simplify litter box maintenance with one intelligent system.

Stay on Top of Your Cat’s Daily Health
With Dual-Camera AI Vision, you can monitor your cat’s litter box activity anytime through live viewing or recorded clips.
Track litter box visits, stool appearance, and behavior patterns so you can notice potential health changes earlier and stay informed about your cat’s wellbeing.

A Fresher Home Starts Here
The fully enclosed capsule design helps contain litter scatter and reduce odors, while active oxygen deodorization works to neutralize odors at the source.
Together they help maintain a cleaner, fresher environment for both you and your cats.

Built for Busy Days and Weekend Getaways
The large 12L waste bin can support up to 14 days of hands-free cleaning for one cat, reducing daily maintenance and making short trips away from home much easier.
Your cat always returns to a clean litter bed, while you enjoy more freedom and less hassle.

Fast and Stable 5GHz Wi-Fi
The Scoop Robot supports high-speed 5GHz Wi-Fi, providing faster and more stable connections than standard smart devices.
Whether you’re checking the live camera feed, reviewing activity logs, or receiving health alerts, you’ll always stay connected.

Safety You Can Trust
Your cat’s safety is always the priority. The 360° Safety Protection System combines infrared sensors and weight sensors to detect nearby movement.
If your cat approaches or steps inside during cleaning, the system automatically pauses operation to prevent accidents.

Effortless Cleaning
Maintenance is designed to be simple and convenient.
The anti-stick silicone pad helps prevent waste from sticking, while removable components allow for quick rinsing and easy deep cleaning when needed.

Key Features
Dual-Camera AI Vision for remote monitoring
AI multi-cat recognition and behavior tracking
Active oxygen deodorization for odor control
Fully enclosed capsule design to reduce litter scatter
Large 12L waste bin for extended hands-free use
High-speed 5GHz Wi-Fi connectivity
360° safety sensor system
Easy-clean removable components

products.body_html:
Meet the All-New CATLINK Scooper Open-X — Designed for Big Cat Families

Say goodbye to cramped litter boxes.
With an open design, the Open-X gives even the largest cats—like Maine Coons—the space they need to feel at ease. Making the switch to a smart litter box has never been simpler.

For travel-loving cat parents
A spacious 12L waste drawer means one cat can use it for up to 15 days. Heading out of town? Relax—the Open-X has you covered.

Easy Connection
Dual-band support for both 2.4GHz & 5GHz WiFi keeps things running smoothly.

Safety First
The unique incomplete gear design ensures the entrance always stays open, so your cat can come and go safely at any time.

Freshness Made Simple
An upgraded waste bin paired with an odor-locking system keeps your home smelling fresh, even while you’re away. Cleaning is effortless: press a button to empty, give it a quick wipe or rinse, and you’re done.

All-in-One Convenience
Compatible with any clumping cat litter, so you don’t have to change what your cat already prefers.

From now on, no more scooping by hand. With the Open-X, your cat enjoys a natural, outdoor-like potty experience—while you enjoy a cleaner, fresher home.

products.title: CATLINK Activated Carbon Cotton Filter for Scooper Pro Ultra / Luxury Pro-X / Young Pro-X
products.body_html:
For CATLINK Scooper Pro Ultra / Luxury Pro-X / Young Pro-X.

Keep your waste bin fresh and odor-free with the power of activated carbon! This filter set uses natural physical adsorption to help neutralize odors effectively.

Why You’ll Love It:
Compatible with multiple CATLINK scoopers– Easily reinstall when upgrading your litter box.
Safe & effective odor control – Uses physical adsorption, making it safe for both cats and humans.
Long-lasting freshness – Each filter lasts 30–60 days for continuous odor absorption.
You can adjust the number of filter sheets in the cartridge based on the number of cats in your home. For optimal performance, CATLINK recommends replacing the activated carbon filter every 60 days.

What's in the Box:
Activated Carbon Filter Cartridge x 1 (installs directly into the litter box waste drawer)
Activated Carbon Cotton Sheets x 2
A simple and effective way to maintain a fresher, cleaner space for you and your cat!
